div.div:
Two domain gates, one project match
Step 1: Firebase rejects a page domain missing from Authorized domains.
Step 3: Core rejects an origin missing from CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (403).
Step 5: Core returns 401 when the token comes from another Firebase project.

div.div:
Preview (pull request)
Web: smart-ledger-preview-0N.vercel.app
N = last digit of the PR number
GitHub env: vercel-preview
Firebase: smart-ledger-c2892 (shared with staging)
Core: core-staging
DB: Supabase staging
Authorized domains + CORS: the 10 preview aliases

Authorized domains + CORS: staging domain

div.div:
Production (push to main, approved)
Web: production domain (not configured)
GitHub env: vercel-production (empty)
Firebase: separate project (not created)
Core: core production
DB: Supabase production
Authorized domains + CORS: production domain

div.div:
Preview and staging share Firebase, Core and the database: data created on a preview shows on staging. Only the web build differs.
Core's CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is the Variable of GitHub environment railway-staging / railway-production, synced to Railway on deploy.
